Types

BodyClause = object
  case
  of IfClause:
    condition*: NimNode
    thenBodyCppCode*: string
  of LetClause:
    letVar*: NimNode
    letValue*: NimNode
    bodyCppCode*: string
  of RelClause:
    relname*: NimNode
    args*: seq[ClauseArg]
ClauseArg = object
  case kind*: ClauseArgKind
  of LVar:
    lvar*: NimNode
  of CppCode:
    cppcode*: string
ClauseArgKind = enum
  LVar, CppCode
Fact = object
  relname*: NimNode
  args*: seq[string]
  annotation*: string
HeadClause = object
  relname*: NimNode
  args*: seq[ClauseArg]
Program = object
  database_name*: NimNode
  relation_decls*: seq[RelationDecl]
  nodes*: seq[ProgramNode]
ProgramNode = object
  case
  of StratumNode:
    stratum*: Stratum
  of CppCodeNode:
    code*: string
RelationDecl = object
  relname*: NimNode
  types*: seq[NimNode]
  semiring*: NimNode
Rule = object
  name*: NimNode
  head*: seq[HeadClause]
  body*: seq[BodyClause]
  order*: seq[NimNode]
Stratum = object
  name*: NimNode
  rules*: seq[Rule]
  facts*: seq[Fact]
